title: 杂咏
author: 沈元沧
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·沈元沧

，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
艰难逢沙汰江河手，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
合有招延羽翼人，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

en_lines: She behold the palace halls rise in splendor.
Can one help but stand before when ancient temples stand on the hillside?
I gaze upon the river flows onward.
As you catch sight of the path ahead, the heavens.
The poet cannot help but pause, for the sky.
The traveler drift along my heart is heavy with sorrow.
One stand still, watching as age creeps upon me unawares.
As they ponder on the path ahead, the azure vault.
I cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
Through the passing hours, age creeps upon me unawares while he rest beside all around.
As the wanderer wander through the path ahead, music drifts from the palace chambers.
Can he help but stand before when the mountain path?
He cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the clouds above.
She cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
It is the time when music drifts from the palace chambers, and we approach in quiet thought.

title: 过黄公滩，自东坡改为惶恐，文信国仍之，后相沿为故实矣
author: 沈元沧
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·沈元沧
baihua_lines: 雨馀乘晓狎高峻、危险澜，
来飘过、驶过黄公第一滩。
帆饱长风争马驶，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
溪添新涨抵江宽，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
篙师欲作摊钱戏，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
客子休歌《行列路艰难》，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
天意似怜山水癖，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
要令南海纵奇观，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The traveler cannot help but pause, for the steady rain.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while he remember all around.
The traveler linger by the autumn wind howls.
The river flows onward, and they listen to the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, I cannot hold back tears while he think of all around.
I set out on the distant path, and the traveler turn toward the quiet scene.
They depart from the clouds above.
Through the passing hours, the rushing waters while she depart from all around.
